full_judgment: 3. The case of the pre-emptor is that the land was recorded and published in S.A. Khatian No. 30 and 55 in the name of Kalu Sheikh who died leaving sons namely Mokbul Hossain, Abul Kashem, Quader, Sabed and daughter Hazera Khatun and the land was recorded rightly in new dhiara khatian in their names. The pre-emptor is the brother of the seller, opposite party no. 2 who transferred the case land on 17.11.2002 to the pre-emptee opposite party no. 1 by a registered deed. The preemptee is a stranger of the case land. No notice was served upon the pre-emptor regarding the transfer of the case land. The pre-emptor came to know about the sale on 03.03.2005 from the local people and thereafter, obtained the certified copy on 5.3.2005 of the sale deed and then instituted the case.
